title: Cut your hand open. Lockjaw.
html_source:
Rudolph Virag worries that his son Leopold will contract tetanus (lockjaw) from the wound in the boy’s hand.

At another layer, he is worried that Leopold will be repressed or silenced by his non-Jewish companions.
